title: ChatItem
description: Run "/trigger chatitem" to show an item in chat!
body:
# ChatItem

Quickly and easily show off your items in chat!

### How to use
Hold the item you want to share, and then type `/trigger chatitem`.
It will send a message in chat that other players can hover over to see your item.

![Item in chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b01192b64f28d8fa42ed2c5700ad16ed4b2985e.png)
